A [[Color/Legends|light-skinned]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''grenadier''' was a member of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]]<ref name="SW:OW" /> [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> As a [[Grenadier/Legends|grenadier]], he wore a uniform similar to that of the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen's]] [[Palace Guard]]. He fought against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] that year when Trade Federation forces [[Capture of Theed/Legends|entered]] the [[Theed/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]. He engaged a [[Grenade droid/Legends|grenade droid]] with his own [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], and fell back to cover. He then met the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who at the time was on a mission to rescue the Queen from her Federation captors.<ref name="SW:OW" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)}}
The grenadier asked Kenobi to follow him, and he showed the Jedi an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] which had other Naboo guards pinned down. The grenadier gave Kenobi several [[Ion grenade/Legends|ion grenades]] and asked him to assist with disabling the tank. The grenadier also told Kenobi to come back for more grenades if he needed them.<ref name="SW:OW" />

Kenobi aided the Naboo guards by dropping an ion grenade on the Armored Assault Tank before continuing with his mission.<ref name="SW:OW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You need more grenades? Here you go.|The grenadier to Kenobi|<ref name="SW:OW" />}}
This grenadier appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]. The player, taking the role of Kenobi, meets him during the game's third chapter. Identified in the subtitles as "Man," he shares the same model with the other grenadiers and his voice actor is not specified. The player can choose to ignore the grenadier's request to help or may destroy the tank. This article assumes the player took the latter choice. The player can also return to the grenadier at any time for more grenades. The player can also kill the grenadier.
